mainText: Good morning, Landon. Here's your brief for Monday, November 16, 2026. First, China has confirmed that its leader will join the American and Russian presidents for their first three way meeting on Thursday, on the sidelines of the Asia Pacific summit in Shenzhen. Nuclear arms control, trade, and the conflict involving Iran are expected to top the agenda, though officials are not predicting a formal agreement. Next, tensions in the Gulf flared again over the weekend. Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted Iranian drones aimed at a base used by American forces, while Iran claimed its strikes hit their targets. Brent crude is trading in the mid nineties per barrel. Next, Japan's economy unexpectedly shrank in the third quarter, contracting at a small annualized rate as high energy import costs and weaker consumer spending weighed on growth. The Nikkei fell about two percent, and stocks in South Korea and Taiwan dropped even more sharply as chip makers sold off. Next, Nvidia reports quarterly results this week, its first report since its longtime chief executive stepped down last week. Finance chief Colette Kress is serving as interim leader, and investors are watching closely for signs of how AI chip demand is holding up. Next, markets are bracing for higher interest rates. The ten year Treasury yield is hovering near five point one five percent, traders are pricing in a possible Federal Reserve rate hike in December, and bitcoin has slipped below seventy thousand dollars for the first time since August. And finally, SpaceX caught a returning Starship upper stage with the mechanical arms of its Texas launch tower for the first time, a major step toward fully reusable rockets. The booster, however, was lost during its own return attempt. Here's your fun fact. The Hawaiian bobtail squid hunts at night using glowing bacteria that live in a special light organ, matching the moonlight above it so predators below cannot see its shadow. Every morning at dawn, the squid flushes out up to ninety five percent of those bacteria, and the few that remain multiply all day to refill the organ by nightfall. Have a great day.
